word.definition: To circumscribe something is to limit its range or activity.

sports_fact.text: The 1944 World Series was an all-St. Louis affair — Cardinals vs. Browns — with every game played at Sportsman's Park. The teams literally shared the stadium.

market.headline: Jane Street Suffers Loss of About $15 Billion Following Troubles at Situational Awareness
market.summary: The trading firm posted its worst month ever in July after bets at Leopold Aschenbrenner’s hedge fund soured.

quote.text: If a religion is not universal, it cannot be eternal. A narrow religion, a sectarian religion, an exclusive religion can live only for a limited time and a limited purpose.
quote.author: Sri Aurobindo

history.text: Tomiichi Murayama, Prime Minister of Japan, releases the Murayama Statement, which formally expresses remorse for Japanese war crimes committed during World War II.
